cover.concept: A single narrow beam of light in bright accent orange cuts down through flat muted-indigo fog to fall on one simple card-shaped silhouette below, and where the beam touches the card a small round counter shape is quietly lighting up in its corner, as if a number is materializing for the first time inside the light.
